title: Valid parity block assignment
statement: For natural numbers $n,r,g$, an assignment $a$ of signs to the $r$ positions is valid if, for every $j<r$ with $n\le g r+j$, its sign is $a(j)=1$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a sign to each of the $r$ positions
